Build 47 failed in test_one_xml_whose_encoding_cannot_be_read_never_stops_the_watch alone (479 passed):
on Windows «ANSI» is Python's name for the system code page (mbcs), so that XML is read there as it should
be. The test now takes an encoding unknown everywhere and gb2312 (a multi-byte encoding the reader refuses).
